title: MIT experiment 8: same-causal-question diagnostic pairs
preparation: Selected after inspection of 85 source notes and an earlier ShadowSeed clustering run. This is a retrospective diagnostic reference, not blinded independent ground truth.
label_definition: SAME only if the two statements concern the same specific testable intervention/claim and its measured question. Related components, edit strength, error categories, or implementation variants are DIFFERENT.
caveats: Provisional expert labels by the same analyst, not independently adjudicated; some comparisons are borderline. Do not describe the counts as model accuracy on an unseen benchmark.
